steps.name: A Place Called Demon Mountain
steps.objective: Talk to [Sera] in the "Guild Inn", then find [Lisione] on "Demon Mountain".

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Recently, various problems have been occurring in one part of the Ell Anor Mountains.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Monster attacks are common enough wherever there are mountains, of course...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: But this time feels very different.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Near the high elves' former territory, once called Bethesda and known as a mysterious earthly paradise...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: We've received reports of monsters believed to be from the demon realm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Monsters from the demon realm? You mean they crossed over from there?

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I don't know the details either.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: The Guild Union and everyone else have their hands full with all sorts of problems right now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What would you like me to do?

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Please go to the area where the problems keep happening, Bethesda. No, I mean...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: The place now called Demon Mountain.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: We need a thorough investigation of what's happening there.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Even some of our regular guests have gone missing while passing through that area.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I'd like to go myself, but my circumstances won't allow it...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: So I turned to you, %s, the most skilled and renowned person I know.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: You've resolved so many problems already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true, but I'm still a little scared.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Are you? Even so, I feel that you could handle it...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: May I entrust you with investigating Demon Mountain?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go and take a look.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Please do. Strange things keep happening everywhere these days as it is.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Oh, already gone. I was going to mention that it's gotten colder there...

steps.name: The Fallen Hall
steps.objective: Defeat four types of monsters on "Demon Mountain", then report to [Lisione].

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Oh, another person has come here. Gallus must have opened another gap in the barrier and lured you inside.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: This place is dangerous! Run, before it's too late!

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Once Gallus's army arrives, you won't be able to escape.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gallus? Who's that?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: He's the demon who turned this place into what you see now.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: There's no time to explain at leisure.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You could die if you're not careful, so run!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Could you explain a little more?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: People have been going missing here lately. Does it have something to do with that demon, Gallus?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'm telling you, Gallus is truly dangerous. He's a demon on an entirely different level.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I'm all right. Could you please keep explaining?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I understand this is serious, but I need to hear what's happening if I'm going to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Demon Mountain, right? Where people keep disappearing...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It isn't Demon Mountain. That's only what people call it because of Gallus. This place was originally Bethesda, protected by a sacred barrier.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: But an earthquake opened dimensional rifts in several places, and monsters emerged from them.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Because of them, everyone in the Green Foliage clan I led... everyone but me... lost their lives.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: This beautiful land, which I failed to protect, became a refuge for demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Then the state you're in now...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's a curse Gallus placed on me. How shameful, a high elf chieftain who can't even break a demon's curse.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I thought I at least had the strength to face a demon... Gallus... Gallus...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: (Lisione mutters Gallus's name in fury, then gradually quiets as if swallowing her anger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me try breaking the ice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ice that won't break... This really isn't ordinary ice. It's...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's no use. It isn't ordinary ice; it was created by a curse...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Please, just run. You may die if you stay here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After seeing you like this, I can't just turn back.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You really are a fool. You see me like this and still say that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. That's the kind of person I am. So I can't simply leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me everything you know.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'll say it again... You really are a fool...

steps.name: Entering the Hall of Mysteries
steps.objective: Defeat [Rubia] and [Minerva], who have taken over the "Hall of Mysteries".

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You're truly remarkable. You dealt with Gallus's army, which filled the whole mountain, in no time...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I knew you weren't an ordinary person, but...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Even so, it's still dangerous. Please withdraw now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There you go again. I'm all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are a few stragglers left, but the mountain is mostly cleared now, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I go next? What should I do?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: ...It will be terribly dangerous from here on too. Will you still keep fighting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've already started, so I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to feel so burdened by it.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Then I'll tell you. Below us is a place called the Hall of Mysteries.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's where the Green Foliage clan would pray to the ancient goddess Seres and gather to share their daily lives.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: We also studied many kinds of natural phenomena there.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Gallus's army has taken it over as well. His close subordinates are staying there now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are they demons too?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'm not entirely sure. They're powerful beings of the demon realm named Rubia and Minerva.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Rubia commands the army, while Minerva destroys her opponents through sheer force...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: That's what I know. Both are frighteningly strong... But if you could defeat them, then surely Gallus too...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I think they stayed here to gather an army.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I want to ask, Lisione. Did they curse you simply to...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Yes. That's right. They trapped me in this curse to torment me. To make me keep watching people walk toward their deaths...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's horrible. I can't forgive it. They're truly monstrous... Though I suppose they can do it because they really are demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go right now and deal with those two in the Hall of Mysteries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I'll do everything I can to find a way to break your curse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait just a little longer. Don't worry. Just a little longer.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You've returned... Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right? The curse seems to have gotten worse while I was away...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Those two didn't know anything. They were simply followers drawn to Gallus's strength...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That seemed true of both Minerva, the spirit, and Rubia.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: There are many things in the demon realm, where demons and their kind dwell, that ordinary reasoning can't explain.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: In the end, they were probably only expendable tools used because they were needed.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Mere chess pieces... They wouldn't know how to break a curse cast by Gallus, who stands above them.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'm all right. I'm simply grateful that you came back...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Thank you for returning safely. Now please go back the way you came. Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Lisione... I can't leave things like this. I need to defeat that demon Gallus, and quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I go next? Please tell me.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'll say it once more: you really are a fool. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Next is Demon Canyon. It once had another name, but I can no longer remember it. Gallus and many other demons are there...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: A demon from the demon realm emerged through a dimensional rift discovered during the great earthquake. He called himself the Bitter Cold.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Gallus of the Bitter Cold...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That doesn't matter. I'll meet Gallus and find a way to break the curse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there's a way to cast it, there must be a way to undo it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So please wait just a little longer, as you have until now. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Urgh... I... To think I would fall like this...

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: If I'd fully recovered from the wounds Lux gave me, I would never have suffered such humiliation at the hands of someone like you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux?

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Yes, Lux. So you know him too. He rose to become a lord of the demon realm. There was a time when I served as a legion commander under him.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: I intended to gather strength here, return to the demon realm, and take my revenge. Now it's all for nothing.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: I even stooped to relying on those fools Minerva and Rubia. And this is how it ends.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: (Gallus sneers at %s, who stands watching him.)

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Defeated by a mere human... Had I fallen to Lux instead, it would have been less galling...

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahaha! Hahahahaha!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A demon's laughter... Disgusting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I want to ask. Why did you curse Lisione to freeze like that instead of killing her outright?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Simply because you wanted to torment her?

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: What are you hoping for? Do you want to hear the obvious answer? Then I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: When I remove part of the barrier around the mountain, those humans called adventurers enter to prove themselves.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: They hear the plight of the pitiful frozen woman and challenge me, one after another. But they never reach me.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: For a time, the woman must have hoped things would improve. The moment that hope turns to despair... the expression on her face is so beautiful.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahaha! When the adventurer dies, the woman who has lost everything cries out. That grief, that agony... It is the finest source of power for demons.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahahaha, hahahaha...

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Does that answer your question?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I break the curse?

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: There is no way to break my curse. Once it is cast, that is the end of it.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: I wanted to make further use of that desire to help the elf woman, but now it's over.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: So stand before her, watch her freeze to death, and sink into despair!!

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: That is my final gift as I die at the hands of a mere human.

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: Hahaha, hahaha, haha...

lines.speaker: 갤루스
lines.text: (As Gallus's laughter fades, the body that sustained him shatters into pieces.)

steps.name: A Story Passed Down
steps.objective: Talk to <Sera Aselot> in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: You've returned safely. I'm all right. So please...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You still say you're all right, even like this...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'm more worried about you than myself. I'm content simply knowing that your kind heart brought you this far.

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'm grateful just that you've returned safely. I won't forget it, even in death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. There was nothing I could do. I wanted to be of more help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Instead, I'll do anything else I can for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything you'd like to ask?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It's all right. You've already done so much. I'm content. So...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: Ah, then would you grant me just one thing?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: It isn't much. Please be my last memory. I truly didn't want to fade away all alone. So...

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: So... would you stay beside me for a little while, so that my final moments won't be lonely?

lines.speaker: 리시오네
lines.text: I'd like to tell you about my childhood. About a peaceful time in the elf village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Gladly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sitting beside Lisione and listening to her story, I picture Bethesda as it was long ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's such a beautiful story. This time, I'll tell you why I came all this way. May I? Lisione... Lisione?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lisione, please... Lisione... Open your eyes. Lisione...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You see... I set out on an adventure to find Iris, and I met you here. And... and...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: So that's what happened...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: It breaks my heart that the demon tormented her so cruelly.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't be of any help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure Lisione has gone to a better place. When I get the chance, I'll go visit her again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If only I'd known more about demons and the demon realm, if only I'd arrived a little sooner...

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: You did everything you could, %s. Please don't blame yourself.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: I'm sorry. Perhaps I gave you a task that was far too difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Please don't blame yourself either, Sera.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels as though incidents involving demons are going to become more frequent...)

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: What's on your mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing... I was just thinking again about what happened there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was wondering a little about what I should do from now on. It's obvious what I need to do, but still...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I'd better go now. I'll see you later, Sera.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Of course. We're always here, so come to us if anything happens. My senior, Platina, said the same thing.

lines.speaker: 세라 아셀롯
lines.text: Oh, already gone. Well, keep your spirits up.
